description: Add 'Check for Updates' section to Settings screen with current version display, check button, status indicator, and download button. Depends on FEAT-001 for UpdateInfo and UpdateService.
steps: Modify lib/screens/main_screen.dart SettingsScreen: Add a new Card widget between 'Reset Statistics' and 'About' sections for update checking.

Create a StatefulWidget _UpdateCheckCard as a private widget in main_screen.dart with state: UpdateInfo? _updateInfo, bool _isChecking, String? _errorMessage. The card should display: leading Icon(Icons.system_update), title 'Check for Updates', subtitle showing current version (from appVersion constant in main.dart) and update status.

Implement the check button: When tapped, set _isChecking=true, call UpdateService.checkForUpdates(appVersion), then set _updateInfo to result and _isChecking=false. Show CircularProgressIndicator while checking.

Display status based on state: if _isChecking show 'Checking...', if _updateInfo?.hasUpdate == true show 'Update available: v{latestVersion}' with green color, if _updateInfo != null && !hasUpdate show 'Up to date' with theme.secondaryTextColor, if _errorMessage != null show error in red.

Add trailing widget: if update available, show ElevatedButton 'Download' that calls UpdateService.openDownloadPage(_updateInfo!.downloadUrl); otherwise show OutlinedButton 'Check' to trigger the check.
Use theme colors from AppThemeColors extension: theme.secondaryTextColor for secondary text, ensure dark theme compatibility by using Card widget (inherits from CardTheme in AppTheme.dark).

Optionally add a non-blocking startup check: In _MavFlowAppState._initializeApp() after loading settings, call UpdateService.checkForUpdates(appVersion) and store result. Pass it to SettingsScreen via a static field or context if user navigates to settings. This is optional - if it complicates the flow, skip it.
acceptance_criteria: Settings screen shows 'Check for Updates' card with current version displayed
Clicking 'Check' button shows loading indicator and then displays result
When update is available, 'Download' button appears and opens GitHub release page in browser
UI correctly renders in both light and dark themes using AppThemeColors
Errors are handled gracefully (no crash on network failure)
verification: Run 'flutter run -d windows' - manually verify Settings screen shows the update card and button works
